itemizedResolutions.point: P1 VIDEO ROTATION GEOMETRY & CANVAS RENDERING (AVMutableVideoComposition)
itemizedResolutions.action: Updated StudioMediaEngine.swift makeVideoComposition(for:): 1) Uses CIImage.oriented(.right / .down / .left) for 90°, 180°, and 270° rotation which guarantees exact per-frame rotation with normalized origin (0,0) and extent dimension swap; 2) Casts composition to AVMutableVideoComposition via mutableCopy(); 3) For 90° and 270° rotations, explicitly updates mutableComposition.renderSize = CGSize(width: baseSize.height, height: baseSize.width) so the canvas geometry matches the rotated frame extent, eliminating any clipping, letterbox distortion, or empty region risk.

itemizedResolutions.point: P1 REQUEST-BOUND NONCE & STATE CHALLENGE BINDING (Client & Server)
itemizedResolutions.action: 1) Client-side AuthView.swift: In SignInWithAppleButton onRequest, generates a cryptographically random raw nonce (UUIDv4 pair), computes SHA-256 via CryptoKit, binds request.nonce = sha256(rawNonce), and delivers raw nonce in POST /api/auth/apple body. 2) Server-side lib/oauth.js: Validates claims.nonce strictly against raw nonce and SHA-256 hash. Fails closed (401) on any nonce mismatch or if token contains nonce claim but client omits challenge.
Implemented single-use token enforcement in lib/oauth.js using a bounded set of consumed JTI / token signatures. Fails closed (401) if a token is presented more than once.

itemizedResolutions.point: P2 ROBUSTNESS: NULL HEADER/CLAIMS, NON-FINITE EXP & BOUNDED JWKS CACHE
itemizedResolutions.action: 1) Verified header and claims are non-null objects; 2) Enforced Number.isFinite(claims.exp) rejecting string, NaN, and Infinity; 3) Implemented bounded 1-hour cache for Apple JWKS with fail-closed behavior on fetch failure.

itemizedResolutions.point: P0 SECURITY TEST SUITE EXTENSION (17 Assertions)
itemizedResolutions.action: Expanded test/test_live_and_contracts_e2e.mjs Section 7 to 17 automated assertions: 1) First-time login 200, 2) Repeat login nil email/name 200, 3) Forged signature 401, 4) Tampered claims 401, 5) Invalid issuer 401, 6) Wrong audience 401, 7) Expired token 401, 8) Missing exp 401, 9) Non-RS256 alg 401, 10) Unknown kid 401, 11) Mismatched sub 400, 12) Missing token 400, 13) Replayed token 401, 14) Valid request-bound nonce 200, 15) Mismatched nonce 401, 16) Missing nonce when required 401, 17) Non-numeric/non-finite exp 401. All 17 passed 100%.
